[[File:Spaceport_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[K-Series spaceport control droid]], a model of spaceport control droid]]
A '''controller droid''', also called a '''spaceport control droid''',<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> '''spaceport controller droid'''<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> '''flight controller droid''',<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref> or a '''traffic control droid''',<ref name="JASB">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a category of [[Class three droid/Legends|class three droid]] that was designed to oversee [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]]. Some models were bipedal, with two arms and an overlapping clamshell shaped head.<ref name="SWS" />

[[M-3PO (Emtrey)/Legends|M-3PO]], known as Emtrey, was a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that served as [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] from around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Emtrey was refitted by an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] named [[Losca]] prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and was fitted with a head from a spaceport control droid.<ref name="RS" />
